record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> also came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

And the prince<WH05387> that <FI>is<Fi> among<WH08432> them shall bear<WH05375><WTH8799> upon <FI>his<Fi> shoulder<WH03802> in the twilight<WH05939>, and shall go forth<WH03318><WTH8799>: they shall dig<WH02864><WTH8799> through the wall<WH07023> to carry out<WH03318><WTH8687> thereby: he shall cover<WH03680><WTH8762> his face<WH06440>, that<WH03282> he see<WH07200><WTH8799> not the ground<WH0776> with <FI>his<Fi>  eyes<WH05869>.

And the cities<WH05892> that are inhabited<WH03427><WTH8737> shall be laid waste<WH02717><WTH8799>, and the land<WH0776> shall be desolate<WH08077>; and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>

Again the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came to me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
